headline: Sensex and Nifty end flat as high crude prices and Fed jitters offset strong earnings from Bajaj Auto and L&T

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Crude oil prices hovering near USD 115 per barrel weighed on market sentiment
Investor caution ahead of the upcoming US Federal Reserve interest rate decision
Significant profit slumps reported by major companies like ACC and Cipla
Selling pressure in the banking and IT sectors capped potential market gains
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty benchmarks closed flat despite experiencing intraday volatility
The Midcap Index outperformed the broader market, gaining 565 points
Bajaj Auto reported a 62% surge in Q2 net profit driven by exports and EV sales
L&T's orderbook jumped 28% as its quarterly revenue and profit beat analyst estimates
summary: The Indian stock market ended flat on October 27 as strong quarterly results from Bajaj Auto and L&T were balanced by high crude oil prices and global macro concerns. While the Midcap Index showed strength with a 565-point gain, sectors like banking and IT faced selling pressure ahead of the US Fed decision. Corporate earnings were mixed, with ACC and Cipla reporting sharp declines in net profit.
